Add a segment property

Source: R/properties.R
ngs_add_property.Rd

Add a segment property

Usage

ngs_add_property(x, values, name, type = NULL, description = NULL)

Arguments

x

Segment properties.

values

Property values, one per segment. Unless type is given, the type is inferred from the values:

  • numbers become "number" properties

  • the first character vector becomes the "label" property, subsequent ones "string" properties

  • factors and lists (e.g. list(c("a", "b"), "c")) become "tags" properties. Tags are made valid by removing leading # and replacing spaces with _.

name

Name (ID) of the property.

type

One of "label", "description", "string", "tags" or "number". Default is to infer the type from values.

description

Optional description of the property.

Value

The modified segment properties.

Examples

props <- ngs_segment_properties(c("1", "2"))
props <- ngs_add_property(props, c("PN", "KC"), name = "type")
props <- ngs_add_property(props, list(c("left", "olfactory"), "right"),
                          name = "tags")
